study: Ohm 1.99.0-1 retained disk usage in Ruff/ty and uv development

metric.name: APFS ATTR_VOL_SPACEUSED minus each empty-volume baseline
excludes: Cargo source downloads and registry index
common Git objects and worktree administrative files
metric.idle_endpoint: At least 30 seconds inactive, then full volume flush and five stable allocation samples.
metric.sampled_peaks: Background allocator samples with a one-second requested interval; query overhead lengthens the period. These are lower bounds on transient maxima.

design.forks: A frozen donor after edit 1 plus nine actual siblings, each replaying edits 2 and 3 and validation.
design.retention: Every cohort retains all worktrees and artifacts through its final idle measurement. Each completed cohort is audited and its captured evidence is archived before its temporary volume is retired.
design.preflight: Verify capacity; concurrent builds on other volumes are allowed. Each cohort uses an isolated APFS volume. Final endpoints wait at least 30 seconds for this workload, flush, and require stable allocation. Command timings are diagnostic only. Package-cache waits are recorded; build-directory lock contention is rejected.
design.interpretation: Paired whole-configuration comparisons against stock Rust; not a controlled comparison between Ohm releases or nine independent developer histories.
